description: What Coffer's window may reach outside its own commands, which is almost nothing: the title bar is drawn in HTML, so it has to ask the window manager to drag and to zoom. Everything else Coffer does goes through a command of its own, and application commands are not gated by this file. Nothing from the dialog plugin is listed: the file picker is opened from Rust and is not reachable from the webview at all. The label is a pattern because locking builds the window again under a new one: a window that took the label of the one just destroyed would never load its page.
